Thanks Priya — I completed the scorecard and attached a short justification.

My read: 5/5 hire. Samantha gave a very practical plan for scaling a stateful inference pipeline and brought useful tradeoffs between consistency and latency that matched our production constraints. The only hesitation is how she'd handle operational runbook creation and on-call triage: interview didn't surface deep experience owning an SRE shift, more on design than ops.

If we want to be conservative, I support a quick follow-up question set (15m) about incident response and postmortem cadence, but I'm comfortable moving to an offer and building ops expectations into the manager onboarding plan.
